title: MV Switch Sideview Battle Screen On/Off?

posts.author: Ruskah
posts.body:
Very simple request, for standard enemy fights I want a sideview battle screen, but for boss fights I want to use the frontview battle screen for dramatic effect (and so I don't have to worry about making new graphics for signature status conditions or anything haha).
Does anyone know a way I can switch this mid-game (not mid-battle, just whilst in the overworld)?

posts.body:
